Zulip only surfaced the original commit bot notification and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying records.

The current authoritative CodeSystem/issue-type source already includes code deleted with display Deleted and a definition for content, usually a resource, that has been deleted; OperationOutcome.issue.code remains required-bound to ValueSet/issue-type.
